name: BHFUSE-bsmd1812
title: BSMD1812 series: resettable polymer PTC fuses in a 1812 surface-mount body, 0.10 A to 4.00 A hold
summary: Resettable polymer PTC thermistors for overcurrent protection, in a 4.5 mm x 3.2 mm (1812) surface-mount body. Resistance rises with temperature, so a fault current heats the device into a high-resistance tripped state; the device resets after the fault. The series runs from 0.10 A to 4.00 A hold current, with maximum voltages from 6 V to 72 V and fault ratings of 40 A or 100 A. Lead-free, halogen-free and RoHS compliant, for reflow soldering.

operation.text: A polymer PTC whose resistance climbs with temperature. Overcurrent heats it until it switches to a high-resistance state that limits the current; it resets after the fault clears. It is a protection device and is not meant to be switched on and off as a switch. Each trip lowers its hold current a little.
The device is not for circuits in which a fault can exceed its Vmax or Imax; past those ratings it can be destroyed, arc or catch fire.
Hold current falls as ambient temperature rises (table and derating curve). Keeping the device away from heat-producing parts limits the effect of outside heat on it.
The hold-current figures at each temperature are measured after a single reflow and are sustained for one hour; they are not ratings for continuous charge or discharge current.

Resistance and other ratings are measured on BHFUSE's designated test board after one reflow. Further heating such as repeated soldering, overmoulding or dispensing degrades them, and the application needs its own verification.
Made for reflow: infrared, vapour phase, hot air, or nitrogen atmosphere for lead-free solder. Solder paste up to 0.25 mm thick. Standard cleaning methods and solvents may be used after reflow.

Hand soldering is discouraged and a hot-air gun must not be used in rework, since overheating raises the internal resistance. Where an iron is used nearby, keep the joint more than 1.5 mm from the PTC, the iron below 350 °C and the contact time to 3 s or less.

Moulding compounds, adhesives, UV-cure glue, silicone, board-wash water and solvents can affect the device and are to be qualified for temperature and time before use. Ethers, benzene-series compounds, ketones, esters and other strong solvents are known to harm it; after cleaning, leave boards in open air for at least 24 h. Potting or gluing should follow soon after mounting; if more than one month passes, store the boards airtight.
In a charging connector, PP is the preferred inner-sleeve material; TPE and PVC are not to be used.
Moisture sensitivity level 2, supplied in sealed packing. Damaged packing is to be quarantined and unused parts resealed. Storage at 0 °C to 30 °C and 30% to 60% RH.
BSMD1812-HHH-VV: B for the brand, SMD for surface mount, 1812 for the 4.5 mm x 3.2 mm size, HHH the hold current in hundredths of an ampere (200 = 2.00 A), VV the voltage rating (30V = 30 V).

rows: land width, along the body length
